I am a U.S. Air Force cyber officer, master instructor, and Director of Student Management at one of the Air Force's primary technical schoolhouses for cyber and communications officers. I hold a doctorate in educational leadership and am preparing for the next chapter: teaching cybersecurity and aviation systems at the university level.

My background spans two technical worlds. I came up through aircraft electrical and avionics maintenance, then moved into cyber. That combination of hands-on systems work, modern offensive and defensive cyber, and a doctoral-level study of how adults actually learn is what I bring into a classroom and into client engagements.

I hold **CISSP**, **GXPN**, **OSCP**, **OSWP**, **Security+**, **PMP**, **TS/SCI**, and **CCAF Master Instructor** credentials, and I am pursuing **FAA Airframe and Powerplant** certification through the military experience pathway.

If you are a department chair, hiring manager, or program lead in cybersecurity, computer science, aviation, or aerospace, or you want to bring me in for a guest lecture, I would be glad to talk: [brandon.r.russell.1@gmail.com](mailto:brandon.r.russell.1@gmail.com).

## Selected work

- **[The United States Air Force pilot diversity dilemma](https://doi.org/10.1108/edi-10-2022-0297).** Peer-reviewed, *Equality, Diversity and Inclusion: An International Journal* (2023).
- **Beyond access: Reimagining air mobility, basing, and endurance in the Indo-Pacific theater.** Peer-reviewed, *Joint Force Quarterly* (forthcoming).
- **Building a password cracker using OpenAI and Rust.** *2600: The Hacker Quarterly* (Spring 2025), with [companion code](https://github.com/Brandon-Russell-1/RustPasswordCracker) on GitHub.
- **[Cleartext](writing.qmd).** A series that walks the network stack one layer at a time and maps the attacks that live at each one.

The full list is on [Publications](publications.qmd), with code on [Projects](projects.qmd).
